text:
maria.csm: Heads up — LumenPay renewal flagged by RevOps. Usage down ~72% last 30d after their security team started a deeper eval. Renewal in 6 weeks. Need quick triage.

priya.ae: Ack. Do we have signal on which flows dropped? prod embeddings or search?

maria.csm: Mostly embedding calls from payments-enrich lambda. Top customers/users unaffected, it's their internal QA and staging traffic that disappeared. Metric query: `SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE account='lumenpay' AND env IN ('staging','qa') AND ts > now() - interval '30 days';` shows near-zero.

javier.se: Security review mentioned stricter egress controls and a new proxy requirement. That can break our SDK if callbacks/whitelisting isn't set. @dan.solutions can confirm SDK behavior?

dan.solutions: Yep — if their proxy blocks websocket/tcp keepalive we see failures for streaming and batch retries. For simple embedding calls over HTTPS it's usually fine, but our client retries might be suppressed by some proxies. Two quick mitigations: 1) provide a signed IP/domain allowlist + TLS fingerprint doc, 2) offer a customer-hosted relay (lightweight) for staging.

priya.ae: LumenPay procurement also said they're evaluating FathomAI (competitor) for cost. We should prioritize security docs and a quick POC for the relay. Do they need an NDA or architecture review?

maria.csm: They asked for an architecture diagram and our KMS / data flow page. They also requested SOC2 extracts and a short runbook for onboarding. I can share docs but need the latest artifact links.

dan.solutions: I have a minimal relay repo we used for a PB pilot last quarter. Can spin up a staging image and hand them a helm chart. ETA ~48h. I'll also paste the relay README and a small config snippet they can run locally.

javier.se: I'll prepare a short note about networking expectations (timeouts, headers to preserve, X-Forwarded-* behavior) and sample curl for debug.

priya.ae: I'll set a touchpoint with their procurement and security leads for tomorrow 10am PT. Maria — can you get the SOC2 + KMS blurb to share before that call?

maria.csm: Yes, uploading to the shared folder now: https://redwoodinternal/sales/lumenpay/docs — SOC2 summary, KMS integrations, architecture diagram (v1).

sec-eval-bot: automated: Security checklist status for account lumenpay: docs_provided=true, relay_offer_pending, soc2_verified=true, last_scan=2026-02-12.

priya.ae: Great. On the competitive front, let's offer a 30-day staging extension + assisted relay setup to reduce friction. If they still press on price we can propose a short-term committed discount tied to renewal. We'll coordinate negotiation if needed.

dan.solutions: Action items: (1) Spin relay image + helm (48h) (2) Send relay README + sample config (today) (3) Javier to write networking debug note (EOD) (4) Maria to confirm docs uploaded (done)

maria.csm: I'll run a short prompt set to validate quality on prod vs relay for their staging flows and report regressions. If quality delta > 3% we escalate to ML eng.

javier.se: Also flag for eng on-call if we see 502/timeout spike after their proxy flips on. We should have a canary route ready.

priya.ae: Thanks team. I'll lead the call tomorrow and loop in legal if we need a short SOW. Reopening this thread after the call with notes. :thumbsup:

maria.csm: TY — feel better about this now. Will post meeting notes + next steps here after 10:00am PT.

priya.ae: meeting notes: summary + next steps (posted afterwards).
